annotations.title: Start the planned products of a batch

description: For a batch made with mode "review": starts the images of the products whose plan is ready (all, or item_ids from get_batch). Without item_ids, products still being planned start by themselves once planned. Spends the credits of their ticked images; refused when the balance does not cover them, then only_what_fits true starts the first ones the credits cover. Call with dry_run true first and tell the person the cost and how many fit. Example: {"batch_id": "…", "dry_run": true}

dry_run.description: Only return products, credits and fits

only_what_fits.description: Start only the first products the credits cover

name: start_batch
title: Start the planned products of a batch
